import numpy as np
def equation(t,P,params):
    a,b,d,e,f,g,h,k,m,w=params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    s=np.sin(w*t); co=np.cos(w*t)
    return a + b*P + d*np.log(P) + e*t + f*t/P + g/P + (h*s + k*co + m*t*s)/P
